data.comment:
Tooling delivered (the measurement itself is time-gated — no full post-deploy period has elapsed):

- `scripts/quota_allowance_report.py` — deterministic, log-derived measurement (no LLM), reusing the shared rotation-aware log discovery `scripts/lib/proxy_logs.py`; parses `quota poll ok`, `quota poll failed`, `quota_surge_bypass entered|left`, `Skipping provider=…: reason=quota_exhausted`, `quota_skip dry_run`, and `quota surge suspended|resumed`.
- Per account it derives monthly periods from the poller's own `resetsAt` anchor (`poll ts + seconds_to_reset`), reports the monthly % from the poll closest to and immediately before the reset, the residual, coverage gap, surge-active hours (total + final 7 days), hard-stop dwell, quota skips (applied vs dry-run), poll failures and stale suspensions; classifies each completed period as target_met (>=90%), below_target, overspend (>= hard stop) or insufficient_data.
- 24 tests in `tests/test_quota_allowance_report.py` (period derivation/rollover, reading-at-reset, target/hard-stop classification, hard-stop dwell, skip/failure attribution, surge pairing + final-window clipping, production log-format parsing, CLI artifacts + invocation record, reproducibility, no-data exit code).
- `docs/dev/quota-surge.md` §9: per-account schedule, the exact reproducible invocation (AC13d), interpretation, and the follow-up rules (AC13c).
- `docs/dev/quota-surge-post-deploy-2026-10-19-baseline.{md,json}`: start-of-measurement baseline (generated from the live logs; intentionally no completed period — nothing to classify).

Why the item stays open: the first *full* post-deploy period ends per account at 2026-11-23 (OPENCODE_API_KEY), 2026-11-30 (OPENCODE_2_API_KEY) and 2026-12-17 (OPENCODE_3_API_KEY). AC13/AC13b cannot be satisfied before those dates, so this item is NOT marked in_review — re-run the recorded invocation after each reset, write the dated report, and open the follow-ups per AC13c.
